scope: WebExtension entry (apps/safari-extension/webextension) loaded unpacked in Edge headless on Windows via WSL2, on a local synthetic course page, trusted CDP input on the page. Toolbar press made with DevTools Extensions.triggerAction on the page tab (runs the real action.onClicked and grants activeTab; not a human click). Harness controls: state read through the worker; captureVisibleTab delayed inside the worker for late-answer cases. Not Safari, iPad or Pencil evidence; no course account.
